author: areibold
quote: I loved GTA V but this strayed from some of my favorite parts. The story is such a drag, and the character systems are more annoying to deal with then fun. Really don’t enjoy Lucia’s character or attitude. Also they haven’t fixed really bad NPC interactions. Also wish I could change the frame rate. There is a lot to say but I can’t believe the price and how long of a wait, usually time and money means quality in the end and this just. What a bummer.
